questions.question: Write 4 sentences in French about hobbies and interests.

points.text: Four sentences using topic vocabulary, with correct adjective agreement, articles and verb conjugation. Include at least two different tenses for Higher tier.

questions.question: Write a paragraph (40-60 words) giving your opinion on hobbies and interests.

points.text: A structured paragraph with: introduction (à mon avis...), opinion with reason (je pense que... parce que...), a different viewpoint (cependant...), and a conclusion (en conclusion...). Use connecting words and varied vocabulary.

questions.question: Translate into French: "I think hobbies and interests is important because..."

points.text: "Je pense que [topic] est important(e) parce que..." — ensure adjective agreement (important vs importante depending on noun gender), correct verb form, and give a specific reason.

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Writing task: Write about leisure activities, reading, music, films; hobbies in different tenses; opinions and reasons. <div class="

points.text: A grade 9 answer will: use at least three tenses accurately; include complex structures (subordinate clauses, pronouns, negation); show precise grammar (agreement, conjugation, spelling); express and justify opinions; include cultural knowledge; use a wide range of vocabulary; be well-organised with connecting words (cependant, en revanche, de plus, en conclusion). Mark scheme: Content (relevance and detail) + Quality of language (accuracy and range) = total marks
